text:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — after the quant4 bring-up on magnet14b-ctx64k we saw a small but reproducible token-level drift starting around 32k tokens when using quant-profile 'Q4A-legacy'. Repro script: https://go/ci/repro/3355
Maria S.: can you paste the minimal repro? how big vs float32 baseline?
Alex P.: minimal run:
```
python -m reproducer --model magnet14b --ctx 65536 --quant q4a --prompt-file examples/long_anchor.txt --seed 42
```
Sam T.: which RoPE config? scaled-phase vs classic?
Alex P.: scaled-phase (phase_scale=0.9) to match new compiler path. If I flip to classic-rope the outputs align with fp32.
Anya K.: sounds like phase interpolation issue. also check KV cache boundary handling — any evictions around 32k in the logs?
Alex P.: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] KVCache: append idx=32768 len=128 ok
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] KVCache: retain window=[0..65535]
[2026-03-20T09:12:03Z] QuantKernel: q4a path used; mempad=64
[2026-03-20T09:12:04Z] ModelOutput: token_mismatch at offset=32795
```
Maria S.: plan: bisect kernels (q4a vs q4b), run with phase_scale=1.0 and phase_scale=0.0, test with KV caching disabled and with synthetic anchor repeats. I'll spin up jobs.
Sam T.: i'll run quick job without phase scaling (phase_scale=1.0) on canary nodes and report.
deploy-bot: Canary test job 3355 started on canary-cluster-3; ETA ~ 18m :rocket:
Alex P.: thanks — tagging results here when ready. small thread but wanted to capture the hypothesis for longctx/kv interplay.
